lines.text: The LORD said He made the earth and has placed all these lands under Cyrus, His servant.
The LORD said He would punish any nation refusing Babylon's yoke, and the prophets saying otherwise prophesied a lie.
Jeremiah told Zedekiah to put his neck under Babylon's yoke and live, and not to heed prophets the LORD had not sent.
Nebuchadnezzar left some articles when he exiled Hezekiah, and they will be carried to Babylon.
